attchmntText: Vardhman Textiles Limited has informed the Exchange about Transcript.
voiceSummary: Vardhman Textiles Limited filed the transcript of its Q2 FY27 earnings conference call with the BSE and NSE on 10th November 2026. The call was held on 6th November 2026. Management reported improved yarn business performance driven by higher demand, rising yarn prices, and trading gains from low-cost cotton purchases. Current cotton landed costs are approximately INR65,000 per candy. The fabric business faced challenges due to lower export volumes, tariff uncertainty, and higher input costs. The company expects improved order pipelines following US election results. An open-end yarn project with a capacity of 50 tons per day is expected to be operational in six to seven months. No major capital expenditure plans for the spinning business have been announced for the next two years.

attchmntText: Vardhman Textiles Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Demat Report for the month ended October, 2026.'.
voiceSummary: Vardhman Textiles Limited reports the dematerialization of 8,950 equity shares during October 2026. The company filed this information with BSE Limited and National Stock Exchange of India Ltd pursuant to SEBI Depositories and Participants Regulations 2018. The total comprises 210 shares dematerialized via CDSL and 8,740 shares via NSDL. Share certificates were cancelled and substituted with the depository as the registered owner. The announcement was issued by Company Secretary Sanjay Gupta on 07.11.2026.

attchmntText: Vardhman Textiles Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication.
voiceSummary: Vardhman Textiles Limited published financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, in Desh Sewak and Business Standard on November 7, 2026. The Board approved the results on November 5, 2026. Consolidated total income from operations was 4,055.59 crores for the six months ended September 30, 2026, with a net loss of 625.14 crores. Standalone total income from operations was 5,595.01 crores, with a net profit of 649.52 crores. Aditya Birla Fashion and Retail Limited published financial results for the same period. Consolidated total income from operations was 10,092.53 crores, with a net profit of 905.07 crores. Sanofi Consumer Healthcare India Limited announced a postal ballot for member approval of material related party transactions with Opella Healthcare India Private Limited and Opella Healthcare International SAS. The e-voting period is from November 7, 2026, to December 6, 2026. The Board declared a second interim dividend of Rs. 14.40 per share. The company bought back 1,858,941 equity shares during the quarter. The Great Eastern Shipping Company Limited published financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. Consolidated total income from operations was 2,890.29 crores, with a net profit of 2,578.07 crores.
